notes.title: Release Date and Price Announcements!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I hope you are having a great day! ☀️
Game release is in 2 days on [b]March 27 at 12AM PST[/b], and I have a few announcements to share with you!

[h2]Piecing It Together Pricing[/h2]
✨[b]Piecing It Together is going to cost $9.99 USD[/b] ✨

As a reminder, the game will be short and sweet, featuring 10 different puzzles with minimal updates later. Expect about 5-10 hours of puzzling, so remember to take your time and relax! 

Plus, there's a [b]small discount when it releases[/b]! Grabbing it early is super helpful for indie devs because it boosts our visibility on Steam, so a big thank you to those who do! 💕

Also, thank you so much to those who have played Piecing It Together's demo and gave us great feedback!

 There's still some work to do before March 27th, so I'll see you then! 💌
